title: Debotaro Portfolio
summary: A personal showcase that connects professional context, considered visual design and six working frontend concepts.
role: Project direction and AI-assisted frontend development
challenge: Give recruiters a quick way to understand Deboraj’s frontend focus, explore working examples and start a conversation.
approach: Lead with a clear professional introduction, place the portfolio itself first, and connect six distinct demos through a consistent gallery. Concise case studies explain the implementation choices behind the visuals.
highlights: Responsive layouts with clear project navigation
Category filtering with an announced result count
Six working demos and public source code
Contact profiles and a downloadable résumé
validation: Desktop and mobile Chromium checks cover identity, filters, demo and source links, keyboard dialogs, menu behavior, clipboard contents, résumé download and document overflow.
limitations: Personal concept project • AI-assisted development. Contact uses an email link; a downloadable résumé and public source are included. There is no contact backend.

title: NOVA OS
summary: A connected workspace for projects, tasks and local automation, with command search and a rule-based assistant.
role: Project direction and AI-assisted frontend development
challenge: Keep projects, tasks, automation and assistant interactions connected so the workspace feels like one product.
approach: Use a shared, typed data model across the dashboard and project views. Pair a restrained dark interface with command search, local automation and a separate marketing and onboarding journey.
highlights: Task changes update project progress
Command search finds destinations and tasks
A rule-based assistant creates workspace tasks
An editable automation flow updates local state
validation: Next.js static export and TypeScript checks pass. Desktop and mobile Chromium scenarios cover task creation, command search, assistant task creation and automation execution.
limitations: Personal concept project • AI-assisted development. Tasks persist in the browser; authentication, team collaboration and external integrations are simulated. The assistant uses deterministic rules.

title: ATLAS Ops
summary: An operations workspace connecting local tasks and staffing views with a live, read-only GitHub issue queue.
role: Project direction and AI-assisted frontend development
challenge: Connect a practical operations dashboard to real external data while keeping remote issues and local planning clearly separate.
approach: Keep operational charts and staffing data local, then add a public GitHub repository queue through a separate typed API boundary. Validate responses at runtime, cancel obsolete requests, handle timeouts and rate limits, and let users import an issue into local tasks without posting to GitHub.
highlights: Editable task board with drag-and-drop and status controls
Live GitHub issues with loading, error and empty states
Validated responses, cancellation and retry handling
Duplicate-safe local issue import with a source link
validation: TypeScript checks and the Vite production build pass. Desktop/mobile Chromium checks cover task persistence and mocked GitHub success, loading, empty, malformed, network, rate-limit, timeout and stale-response behavior. A separate unmocked browser smoke check verified the actual public API.
limitations: Personal concept project • AI-assisted development. GitHub reads live public repository data; the latest page contains at most 30 raw entries and excludes pull requests. API rate limits apply. Imported tasks, operations charts and staffing remain local; there are no GitHub writes, ERP connection or shared backend.

title: NILA Ledger
summary: A personal finance interface built around consistent transaction data, editable budgets and useful exports.
role: Project direction and AI-assisted frontend development
challenge: Make income, spending and budgets understandable without overwhelming the transaction view.
approach: Use one financial model for the ledger, charts, budgets and reports. Store amounts as integer pennies, then format them for display; pair a quiet visual hierarchy with practical filters and exports.
highlights: Transaction creation, editing and deletion
Monthly, category and date filters
Editable budgets linked to recorded spending
Filtered CSV exports and printable monthly reports
validation: TypeScript checks and the Vite production build pass. Desktop and mobile Chromium scenarios cover a £12.50 transaction, filtered CSV download, persisted data and budget editing.
limitations: Personal concept project • AI-assisted development. Financial records are fictional and saved locally; there is no bank connection or account authentication.

title: AURA Reserve
summary: An atmospheric hospitality concept with a practical, validated stay enquiry journey.
role: Project direction and AI-assisted frontend development
challenge: Preserve the atmosphere of a hospitality brand while making stay planning clear and usable.
approach: Pair generous editorial spacing and cinematic imagery with a visible booking entry point. Validate the stay before displaying a residence and illustrative quote, and keep essential controls independent of optional animation.
highlights: Date and sample availability validation
Capacity-aware residence selection
Calculated nightly quotes and enquiry completion
Native gallery dialogs with keyboard navigation
validation: Desktop and mobile Chromium scenarios cover a stay enquiry, quote calculation and keyboard gallery navigation. Core enquiry controls also work when the animation CDN is blocked.
limitations: Personal concept project • AI-assisted development. Rates and availability are illustrative. The form creates a demo state; it does not send an email or reserve accommodation.

title: VANTA Atelier
summary: An editorial fashion concept with size selection, a persistent shopping bag and a complete demo checkout.
role: Project direction and AI-assisted frontend development
challenge: Combine a confident editorial identity with a shopping flow that remains easy to follow.
approach: Use oversized typography and a restrained palette around a compact catalogue. Keep product size, quantities and totals consistent through selection, a persistent bag and a clearly labelled demo checkout.
highlights: Category filters and product size selection
Cart entries keyed by product and size
Stored cart data validated against the catalogue
Keyboard focus preserved during cart updates
validation: Desktop and mobile Chromium scenarios cover filtering, size selection, persistence, quantity totals and demo checkout. Keyboard checks verify focus after size and quantity changes.
limitations: Personal concept project • AI-assisted development. Products and photography are illustrative. Checkout collects no card details, processes no payment and fulfils no order.

title: RASA Experience
summary: A travel concept that turns destination discovery into a sample itinerary through a globe, quiz and downloadable journey plan.
role: Project direction and AI-assisted frontend development
challenge: Give an inspirational travel page a clear path from destination discovery to a sample itinerary.
approach: Connect destination buttons, an optional interactive globe and itinerary details. A three-step quiz offers a sample recommendation; a journey form turns selected preferences into an on-screen summary and downloadable plan.
highlights: Interactive globe with geographic destination pins
Destination buttons as a keyboard and WebGL fallback
Three-step quiz with sample recommendations
Itinerary selection and downloadable text plans
validation: Desktop and mobile Chromium scenarios cover destination selection, itinerary details, quiz output and a sample plan download. Essential controls also work when the Three.js CDN is blocked.
limitations: Personal concept project • AI-assisted development. Recommendations, prices and itineraries are illustrative. No travel operator is contacted and no transport or accommodation is booked.
